title: Ath Dinner and Critical Response Paper
description: Mandatory class Ath dinner featuring a presentation by Professor Sharda Umanath, followed by a required response paper.

source.quote: We will have a class Ath dinner on Thursday, November 12 (5:30 – 8 pm) where we will hear a presentation by Professor Sharda Umanath...The Ath Dinner is mandatory for all students in the class.

title: Guest Speaker Critical Response Paper
description: Response paper addressing the in-class discussion with Professor Basu on her paper 'The Importance of Forgetting.'

source.quote: On Monday, October 26, Professor Basu will be attending our class to answer questions about her paper "The Importance of Forgetting,"...The response paper is worth 20 points.

title: Extra Credit: Memory Meme/Joke Submission
description: Optional extra credit for emailing a meme, cartoon, drawing, TikTok, or joke relating to memory before the start of class.

source.quote: I will award you one extra credit point for emailing me with a meme, cartoon, original drawing, TikTok, or joke relating to memory prior to the start of class on Wed., Sept. 2.

title: Extra Credit: Catching Professor Using Cell Phone
description: Class-wide extra credit awarded if a student catches the professor using her cell phone for non-timing purposes.

source.quote: If anyone catches me using my cell phone during class for any other purpose, everyone in the class will receive 2 extra credit points.
